package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for optional_tx_nil_parameter_on_repository_api: Repository APIs that use optional `tx *gorm.DB` parameters instead of explicit unit-of-work contracts.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type User struct {
	ID   int    `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Name string `gorm:"column:name"`
}

type UserRepo struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func (r *UserRepo) FindByID(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, id int) (*User, error) {
	if tx != nil {
		return r.find(ctx, tx, id)
	}
	return r.find(ctx, r.db, id)
}

func (r *UserRepo) find(ctx context.Context, db *gorm.DB, id int) (*User, error) {
	var user User
	err := db.WithContext(ctx).Where("id = ?", id).First(&user).Error
	return &user, err
}
